title: Grocery Standby Amount on the Late-Express Credit (Northgate Store and Online Orders)
content:
**Rule.** The late-express credit on a Northgate Same-Day Delivery express order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders** includes a flat grocery standby amount, added to the credit and counting the order's grocery lines:

| Grocery lines on the order | Standby amount |
|---|---|
| two or more | seventy-five cents (0.75) for each line |
| exactly one | a flat one dollar (1.00) |
| none | nothing |

**Hypothetical orders.** Eight grocery lines give 6.00, being 0.75 multiplied by 8; two give 1.50; one gives 1.00.
